description: This file defines the AWS Amplify client class within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various Amplify service operations and extends a generic AWS client class.

classes.name: AmplifyClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with AWS Amplify service, providing methods for managing Amplify applications and resources.

methods.name: createBackendEnvironment
methods.description: Creates a backend environment for an Amplify app.

methods.name: createBranch
methods.description: Creates a new branch for an Amplify app.

methods.name: createDeployment
methods.description: Creates a deployment for an Amplify app.

methods.name: createDomainAssociation
methods.description: Associates a domain with an Amplify app.

methods.name: createWebhook
methods.description: Creates a webhook for an Amplify app.

methods.name: deleteDomainAssociation
methods.description: Disassociates a domain from an Amplify app.

methods.name: getApp
methods.description: Retrieves details for an Amplify app.

methods.name: getArtifactUrl
methods.description: Gets the URL for an artifact.

methods.name: getBackendEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves details of a backend environment.

methods.name: getDomainAssociation
methods.description: Gets details of a domain association.
